results.content: Trump’s slide in the polls in recent weeks could signify good news for Democrats ahead of November’s midterm elections. In the newest Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats hold an 8-point lead over the GOP in a generic congressional ballot.
results.title: Trump's approval rating hits yet another record low in latest poll

results.content: A survey from YouGov/Economist released last week shows that in a generic congressional vote, 36 percent of U.S. adults would pick the Democratic candidate compared to 31 percent who would pick the Republican candidate. One percent said other, eight percent said not sure and 23 percent said they would not vote. The poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adults from August 28 to August 31 and had a margin of error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points. [...] A Quantus Insights poll shows that among 1,200 likely voters, 49.7 percent would pick Democrats in the generic congressional ballot compared to 42.8 percent for Republicans and 7.5 percent were undecided.
